desc: Prove that sorting all three arrays in descending order makes the triple-value function monotone along every index direction.
Design the max-heap enumeration over triples, including the three valid neighboring states for each popped state.
Ensure duplicate index triples are prevented with a `visited` set while allowing equal numeric values from different triples.
Analyze complexity: sorting costs `O(N log N)`, while heap processing costs `O(K log K)` with `O(K)` extra memory.
Implement stdin parsing and output the value from the K-th heap extraction using Python integers.
Run the implementation against all provided sample tests and verify outputs.
